_comment: What two documents supplied by the owner on 2026-10-14 say, reduced to what
the site may act on. The documents themselves are not in the repository.
Document A: 'Avrupa Tiny House & Modüler Ev Pazarı — Son 5 Yıl İthalat–
İhracat Analizi' (trade intelligence report, prepared 2026-10-13, HS 9406 and
8716.10, Germany excluded by design). Its figures come from UN Comtrade /
WITS, OEC, IndexBox, TrendEconomy, Trading Economics, Statistics Estonia and
named market-research houses; it marks every unit count as derived from
weight, and the site repeats none of its numbers as a claim. They are here
so the next decision about markets starts from the same table.
Document B: 'MODUNERA — Almanya 100 Potansiyel B2B Müşteri Listesi': one
hundred named operators with web, telephone and e-mail. The list is a sales
asset and belongs in a CRM. This file keeps only its shape — how many of
which kind, in which landscape — because the shape is what decided which
pages to build. No name, domain, number or address from it is stored here
or anywhere else in the repository, which is public.
Nothing in this file is rendered. It is read by people.

report.scope: HS 9406 prefabricated buildings (9406.10 wood, 9406.20 modular steel, 9406.90 other) plus 8716.10 for wheeled units; 2020–2024 full years, 2025 partial; Germany excluded from the ranking
report.caveat: Customs data is reported in USD and kilograms. There is no 'tiny house' code; every unit count in the report is weight divided by an assumed 4–8 t per unit and is labelled an estimate there.
report.turkey_main_markets: Gulf and Central Asia, not Europe; Europe is roughly 15–20 % of 9406 exports. Largest European destination: the Netherlands (16.6 M$ in 2022, 7.8 M$ in 2024); the UK is the most-requested market for wheeled units (10.5 M$ in 2024).
report.romania_position: Second-ranked exporter in the report; ~20 % cheaper per tonne than Turkey (≈2,200 vs 2,766 $/t), capacity-limited, EU-internal. The report's advice is not to compete with Romania on price but on finish, design, delivery speed and full fit-out.

retail_benchmarks_2026_eur._unit: fully fitted 20 m² / 30 m², as quoted in the report from retail price guides; a benchmark, not a MODUNERA price

report.market_size: European tiny-home end-user market ≈245 M$ in 2024, ≈19.7 % CAGR to 2031 in the report's source; France the fastest-growing sub-market there; mobile (wheeled) share ≈60 %.

b2b_segments.typical_order: 50–300 stackable modules; EN 1090 steel certification required

compliance_items_the_report_names: GPSR responsible representative in the EU
NL BENG and FR RE2020 energy files
FR habitat léger and UK Caravan Act compatible wheeled model (≤ 3,500 kg, O2 chassis)
UKCA and a post-Brexit customs broker for the UK
open_points_the_report_itself_lists: A verified importer list (paid bill-of-lading data)

by_category._method: The list's own category column; two records whose category wrapped across lines were assigned by reading the record.

by_tourism_region._method: Keyword match on the list's one-line descriptions against the ten regions in data/tourism-regions.json. 54 records carry no landscape cue in their description and are not counted; one record matched two regions. These are cues, not geocoded positions.

notes: Several records are Austrian (Salzburger Land, Kärnten) or Europe-wide chains headquartered outside Germany; the list is 'Germany-facing', not strictly German.

The categories map one-to-one onto the six operator segments in data/commercial.json: camping ← Glamping/Camping and Tiny-House-Park; ferienpark ← Ferienpark/Feriendorf; hotel ← Naturhotel; marina ← Marina; gemeinde ← Gemeinde/Tourismusverband; dorf ← Ökodorf and Tiny-House-Siedlung.
What the list does not contain and the site therefore does not claim: that any of these operators has enquired, bought, or been delivered to.

2026-10-14: data/commercial.json → /gewerblich/ and /en/commercial/ with six segment pages and the enquiry form with a use preset
data/tourism-regions.json → /regionen/ and /en/regions/ with ten landscape pages, towns assigned by coordinates
data/blog-daily-3.json and -4.json → ten operator-practice posts, 2026-10-15 to 2026-10-24
FR added to the markets in data/market-scan-config.json; country-link fallback in build-news-v7.mjs
Third column 'Für Betreiber' in the Tiny Houses menu; 'Regionen' entry in the Länder menu
not_done_and_why: BE and UK markets: a market-entry decision (dealer, UKCA, customs broker) for the owner, not a query list to add
'Nummer 1 im Tiny-House-Markt': not a publishable claim; the validators ban superlatives without a source, and the report ranks Turkey third as a supplier
Reference projects on the operator pages: none may be named until section 8 of REQUIRED-BUSINESS-INPUTS.md is answered
A French country page under /fr/: the French sections exist, the country page does not; a build decision for the next batch
